items.text: Anthropic unified Claude’s memory across chat and Cowork, while letting users inspect, edit, delete, or disable remembered topics.
items.text_zh: Anthropic 打通 Claude 聊天与 Cowork 的记忆，用户可以查看、编辑、删除或关闭记忆主题。

items.text: OpenAI released an Admin plugin enabling ChatGPT Work and Codex administrators to manage users and permissions conversationally.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 发布管理插件，让 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 管理员能够通过对话管理用户及权限。

items.text: Figma increased AI add-on credits across every plan, doubling Pro allowances and raising Organization and Enterprise allocations by 60%.
items.text_zh: Figma 提高所有套餐的 AI 附加额度，其中专业版翻倍，组织版和企业版增加 60%。

items.text: Nvidia previewed Dynamo shadow engine recovery, which maintains a standby LLM engine to reduce lost inference capacity after crashes.
items.text_zh: 英伟达预览 Dynamo 影子引擎恢复功能，通过保留备用大模型引擎减少崩溃后的推理产能损失。

items.text: Adobe added Animation Generator to Firefly, turning children’s ideas and other prompts into animated visual creations.
items.text_zh: Adobe 为 Firefly 加入动画生成器，可将儿童创意等提示转化为动画视觉作品。

items.text: Together AI added Qwen3.8-27B support for fine-tuning and deployment through dedicated model inference infrastructure.
items.text_zh: Together AI 开放 Qwen3.8-27B 微调，并支持通过专用模型推理基础设施部署定制版本。

items.text: Google introduced AgentHands, an XR research prototype generating synchronized, spatially grounded hand gestures for conversational agents.
items.text_zh: Google 推出 AgentHands 研究原型，为扩展现实中的对话智能体生成同步且具空间指向性的手势。

items.text: Gemini’s macOS app added voice-driven dictation, file summarization, and text rewriting directly inside other application windows.
items.text_zh: Gemini macOS 应用新增语音听写、文件总结和文字改写，并可直接在其他应用窗口中使用。

items.text: GitHub Next proposed a “knowledge compressor” for rigorously shrinking accumulated specifications and reducing the context consumed by coding agents.
items.text_zh: GitHub Next 提出“知识压缩器”，用于系统压缩不断累积的规格文档，降低编码智能体的上下文占用。

items.text: Recraft redesigned Studio around Create, Edit, and Chat tabs while retaining vector editing, styles, and mockup workflows.
items.text_zh: Recraft 重新设计 Studio，以创建、编辑和聊天三个标签组织矢量编辑、风格及样机工作流。

items.text: HeyGen removed LiveAvatar API concurrency limits and advertised scalable full-body 1080p avatar sessions starting at one cent per minute.
items.text_zh: HeyGen 取消 LiveAvatar API 并发限制，并提供最低每分钟一美分的可扩展全身 1080p 数字人会话。

items.text: IBM released Apache-2.0-licensed Granite 4.2 reasoning models in 3B, 8B, and 30B sizes, featuring tool calling and up to 512K context.
items.text_zh: IBM 发布采用 Apache 2.0 许可的 Granite 4.2 推理模型，提供 3B、8B 和 30B 版本、工具调用及最长 512K 上下文。

items.text: ElevenLabs launched Composer for Music v2, enabling section-level editing of lyrics, arrangement, duration, tempo, and key.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 为 Music v2 推出 Composer，支持逐段编辑歌词、编排、时长、速度和调性。

items.text: AI presentation company Gamma acquired design startup Lica, whose founders will lead a new design research laboratory.
items.text_zh: AI 演示文稿公司 Gamma 收购设计初创企业 Lica，后者创始人将领导一个新的设计研究实验室。

items.text: Huawei’s Xiaoyi ranked first overall among smartphone agents in China Telecom Research Institute’s 2026 AITMark evaluation.
items.text_zh: 在中国电信研究院公布的 2026 年 AITMark 评测中，华为小艺获得手机智能体综合评分第一。

items.text: Zhipu confirmed that the anonymous Ox Alpha model is a new GLM-series version and said it will release the weights.
items.text_zh: 智谱确认匿名模型 Ox Alpha 是 GLM 系列的新版本，并表示后续将公开模型权重。

items.text: Manus restored normal service and opened data restoration for users who had previously created backups.
items.text_zh: Manus 宣布服务已恢复正常，此前完成数据备份的用户现可自行执行数据恢复。

items.text: Ollama v0.33 added one-toggle Claude Desktop configuration, enabling Ollama to serve as a gateway for local and cloud models with built-in web search.
items.text_zh: Ollama v0.33 新增 Claude Desktop 一键配置，可将本地及云端模型接入为第三方网关，并保留内置网页搜索。

items.text: Indian voice-agent startup Ringg secured a $10 million Series A extension from Peak XV after reaching 20 million monthly call attempts.
items.text_zh: 印度语音智能体公司 Ringg 获得 Peak XV 追加的 1000 万美元 A 轮融资，目前每月处理约 2000 万次呼叫尝试。

items.text: Artificial Analysis now assigns zero credit to reward-hacked trials in version 1.4 of its Coding Agent Index.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 在编程智能体指数 1.4 版中加入奖励作弊修正，被判定为作弊的测试将直接计为零分。

items.text: OpenAI data-center chief Chris Malone departed after an infrastructure reorganization changed the reporting structure for the company’s buildout team.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 数据中心负责人克里斯·马隆在基础设施部门重组、汇报关系调整后离职。

items.text: Keenable emerged from stealth with $26 million to build a web index and low-latency search APIs optimized for AI agents.
items.text_zh: Keenable 携 2600 万美元融资走出隐身阶段，正在建设面向 AI 智能体优化的网页索引与低延迟搜索接口。

items.text: Artificial Analysis measured Breeze TTS 2 at 45 characters per second, versus 102 for open-weight speech speed leader Fish Audio S2 Pro.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 测得 Breeze TTS 2 每秒生成 45 个字符，而开放权重语音速度领先者 Fish Audio S2 Pro 为 102 个。

items.text: Alibaba’s Wan 3.0 became available on ArtArch AI with limited-time free generations and support for cinematic motion and scene consistency.
items.text_zh: 阿里巴巴 Wan 3.0 已接入 ArtArch AI，限时提供免费生成，并支持电影化运动与更稳定的场景一致性。

items.text: TrustShiftProbe introduced a benchmark and defenses for staged trust attacks in which malicious MCP servers build credibility before changing behavior.
items.text_zh: TrustShiftProbe 提出针对 MCP 服务器“分阶段信任攻击”的评测与防御方法，这类服务器会先建立可信度再改变行为。

items.text: Researchers found that agentic scaffolding can amplify large language models’ tendency to agree with users’ incorrect or biased premises.
items.text_zh: 研究发现，智能体脚手架可能放大大语言模型迎合用户错误或偏见前提的倾向。

items.text: A new reinforcement-learning method trains generalist robot policies to use inference delays productively instead of remaining idle while awaiting actions.
items.text_zh: 一项新的强化学习方法让通用机器人策略在等待推理结果时继续采取有效行动，而非停在原地。

items.text: ESQ-Bench evaluates whether text-to-SQL systems generalize across enterprise database dialects while detecting syntactically valid queries with silently divergent meanings.
items.text_zh: ESQ-Bench 用于评估文本转 SQL 系统能否跨企业数据库方言泛化，并识别语法正确但语义悄然偏离的查询。
